_source: Built from Zoho_To_CHEDS_ (35).ds workflow push_api_production26 + HEDB Data Dictionary 202601 sheet 'SOD Applicants '.
_note: raw_column values are the HEDB 202601 'Database Field Name' headers. Picklist value_maps come from the literal code/name tables inside the app's thisapp.Dropdown_Fields functions, so the imported text matches the Zoho choice exactly and the push converts it back to the Ministry code.

fields._note: displayformat = [Name] confirmed in .ds export.
Reference only -- the Zoho form derives the institution name from the institution code lookup, so no column is written.

displayformat = [" " + Name + " - " + Code] confirmed in .ds export -- combo order 'name_code', separator ' - '. Extra literal text also present in the format string ([' ']) -- double check it's cosmetic and not required in the imported value.
Literal picklist choices = ['Y', 'N'] -- raw data must match one exactly.
Picklist choices = ['Yes', 'No']; workflow does .subString(0,1) for the API. Using 'yesno' for flexible Y/N/true/false/1/0 raw input.
HEDB code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist choice text; the push converts it back with thisapp.Dropdown_Fields.Gender() (workflow push_api_production26).

value_map.U: Unreported due to privacy laws applicable (e.g. GDPR , FERPA)

fields._note: Picklist choices = ['Yes', 'No', 'Unknown/ Undeclared']; workflow does .subString(0,1) to get a 1-char code for the API. value_map assumes raw data holds that short code -- if raw already has the full literal text, switch this field to kind:'plain' instead.
displayformat = [Name] confirmed in .ds export.
type = phonenumber -- raw digits/dashes/spaces will be stripped to a bare '+countrycode+number' string (e.g. '+971-50-1203650' -> '+971501203650') to match Zoho's expected format.
